Thank you for taking the time to separating this post and for the addition of the version number. It agree it’s imperative for our chain integrity that all changes to proposals are recorded and have indications. As accountability is our strongest value, i'm **looking forward** to the pilot, and testing of version pallet with integration to existing or new solutions for collaborative communications that can have onchain references of changes.   

Sent a direct message for clarity on _post paid_ details and for additional final thoughts regarding contributor stability.
